days as 'ايام الدوام'
FROM (
    SELECT 
        inner_results.*,
        -- Calculate if this specific employee has ANY assignment marked as default (1)
        -- This creates a flag '1' for all rows of an employee if at least one row is default
        MAX(inner_results.is_default) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_results.employee_id) as emp_has_default_flag
    FROM (
        SELECT
            e.name AS employee_id,
            e.employee_name,
            dep.department_name,
            e.designation,
            e.branch,
            ssa.title AS shift_title,
            ssa.shift_type,
            st.start_time,
            st.end_time,
            ssa.shift_type_2,
            st2.start_time as start_time2,
            st2.end_time as end_time2,
            ssa.is_default,
            CASE
                WHEN ssa.include_employees = 'Exclude Only' 
                     AND EXISTS (
                         SELECT 1 
                         FROM `tabSpecial Shift Assignment Employee Table` emps 
                         WHERE emps.employee = e.employee 
                           AND emps.parent = ssa.name
                     )
                THEN 'خارج الشفت'
                ELSE 'داخل'
            END AS employee_status,
            GROUP_CONCAT(
                
                CASE LOWER(dow.day_name)
                    WHEN 'saturday'    THEN 'السبت'
                    WHEN 'sunday'   THEN 'الاحد'
                    WHEN 'Monday' THEN 'الاثنين'
                    WHEN 'thursday'  THEN 'الثلاثاء'
                    WHEN 'Wednesday'    THEN 'الاربعاء'
                    WHEN 'Tuesday'  THEN 'الخميس'
                    WHEN 'Friday'    THEN 'الجمعة'
                END
                
                
                ORDER BY 
                
                CASE LOWER(dow.day_name)
                    WHEN 'saturday'    THEN 1
                    WHEN 'sunday'   THEN 2
                    WHEN 'Monday' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'thursday'  THEN 4
                    WHEN 'Wednesday'    THEN 5
                    WHEN 'Tuesday'  THEN 6
                    WHEN 'Friday'    THEN 7
                END
                desc
                 SEPARATOR ' ,'
            ) AS days
        FROM `tabEmployee` e
        INNER JOIN `tabSpecial Shift Assignment` ssa
            ON (
                ssa.include_employees = 'Include All'
                OR (
                    ssa.include_employees = 'Include Only'
                    AND EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 
                        FROM `tabSpecial Shift Assignment Employee Table` emps 
                        WHERE emps.employee = e.employee 
                          AND emps.parent = ssa.name
                    )
                )
                OR ssa.include_employees = 'Exclude Only'
            )
        INNER JOIN `tabDepartment` dep on dep.name = e.department
        INNER JOIN `tabShift Type` st on st.name = ssa.shift_type
        LEFT JOIN `tabShift Type` st2 on st2.name = ssa.shift_type_2

            ssa.title,
            ssa.include_employees,
            ssa.shift_type,
            ssa.is_default,
            ssa.shift_type_2
    ) AS inner_results
) AS final_filter
WHERE 
    -- LOGIC: 
    -- 1. If the employee has a default record (flag=1), show ONLY records where is_default=1
    (emp_has_default_flag = 1 AND is_default = 1)
    OR 
    -- 2. If the employee has NO default records (flag=0), show ALL their records

SELECT
employee_id as 'ID',
employee_name as 'اسم الموظف',
department_name as 'القسم',
designation as 'التخصص',
branch as 'الفرع',
shift_type as 'الشفت الاول',
CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%H:%i'),' -> ', DATE_FORMAT(end_time, '%H:%i')) as 'الفترة الاولى',
shift_type_2 as 'الشفت الثاني',
CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(start_time2, '%H:%i'),' -> ', DATE_FORMAT(end_time2, '%H:%i')) as 'الفترة الثانية,
days as 'ايام الدوام'
FROM (
    SELECT 
        inner_results.*,
        -- Calculate if this specific employee has ANY assignment marked as default (1)
        -- This creates a flag '1' for all rows of an employee if at least one row is default
        MAX(inner_results.is_default) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_results.employee_id) as emp_has_default_flag
    FROM (
        SELECT
            e.name AS employee_id,
            e.employee_name,
            dep.department_name,
            e.designation,
            e.branch,
            ssa.title AS shift_title,
            ssa.shift_type,
            st.start_time,
            st.end_time,
            ssa.shift_type_2,
            st2.start_time as start_time2,
            st2.end_time as end_time2,
            ssa.is_default,
            CASE
                WHEN ssa.include_employees = 'Exclude Only' 
                     AND EXISTS (
                         SELECT 1 
                         FROM `tabSpecial Shift Assignment Employee Table` emps 
                         WHERE emps.employee = e.employee 
                           AND emps.parent = ssa.name
                     )
                THEN 'خارج الشفت'
                ELSE 'داخل'
            END AS employee_status,
            GROUP_CONCAT(
                
                CASE LOWER(dow.day_name)
                    WHEN 'saturday'    THEN 'السبت'
                    WHEN 'sunday'   THEN 'الاحد'
                    WHEN 'Monday' THEN 'الاثنين'
                    WHEN 'thursday'  THEN 'الثلاثاء'
                    WHEN 'Wednesday'    THEN 'الاربعاء'
                    WHEN 'Tuesday'  THEN 'الخميس'
                    WHEN 'Friday'    THEN 'الجمعة'
                END
                
                
                ORDER BY 
                
                CASE LOWER(dow.day_name)
                    WHEN 'saturday'    THEN 1
                    WHEN 'sunday'   THEN 2
                    WHEN 'Monday' THEN 3
                    WHEN 'thursday'  THEN 4
                    WHEN 'Wednesday'    THEN 5
                    WHEN 'Tuesday'  THEN 6
                    WHEN 'Friday'    THEN 7
                END
                desc
                 SEPARATOR ' ,'
            ) AS days
        FROM `tabEmployee` e
        INNER JOIN `tabSpecial Shift Assignment` ssa
            ON (
                ssa.include_employees = 'Include All'
                OR (
                    ssa.include_employees = 'Include Only'
                    AND EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 
                        FROM `tabSpecial Shift Assignment Employee Table` emps 
                        WHERE emps.employee = e.employee 
                          AND emps.parent = ssa.name
                    )
                )
                OR ssa.include_employees = 'Exclude Only'
            )
        INNER JOIN `tabDepartment` dep on dep.name = e.department
        INNER JOIN `tabShift Type` st on st.name = ssa.shift_type
        LEFT JOIN `tabShift Type` st2 on st2.name = ssa.shift_type_2
        LEFT JOIN `tabDays of Week Table` dow
            ON dow.parent = ssa.name
            AND dow.parenttype = 'Special Shift Assignment'
            AND dow.parentfield = 'days_of_week'
        GROUP BY
            dep.department_name,
            e.designation,

    END as 'الفترة الاولى',

        ELSE NULL 
    END as 'الفترة الثانية',
    days AS 'ايام الدوام'
FROM (
    SELECT 
        inner_results.*,
        MAX(inner_results.is_default)
            OVER (PARTITION BY inner_results.employee_id) AS emp_has_default_flag
    FROM (
        SELECT
            e.name AS employee_id,
            e.employee_name,
            dep.department_name,
            e.designation,
            e.branch,
            ssa.title AS shift_title,
            ssa.shift_type,

            ssa.shift_type_2,
            st2.start_time AS start_time2,
            st2.end_time AS end_time2,
            ssa.is_default,
            GROUP_CONCAT(
                CASE LOWER(dow.day_name)
                    WHEN 'saturday'  THEN 'السبت'
                    WHEN 'sunday'    THEN 'الاحد'
                    WHEN 'monday'    THEN 'الاثنين'
                    WHEN 'tuesday'   THEN 'الثلاثاء'
                    WHEN 'wednesday' THEN 'الاربعاء'
                    WHEN 'thursday'  THEN 'الخميس'
                    WHEN 'friday'    THEN 'الجمعة'
                END
                ORDER BY
                    CASE LOWER(dow.day_name)
                        WHEN 'saturday'  THEN 1
                        WHEN 'sunday'    THEN 2
                        WHEN 'monday'    THEN 3
                        WHEN 'tuesday'   THEN 4
                        WHEN 'wednesday' THEN 5
                        WHEN 'thursday'  THEN 6
                        WHEN 'friday'    THEN 7
                    END DESC
                SEPARATOR ' ,'
            ) AS days
        FROM `tabEmployee` e

        LEFT JOIN `tabSpecial Shift Assignment` ssa

                ssa.is_active = 1 AND (
                    ssa.include_employees = 'Include All'
                    OR (
                        ssa.include_employees = 'Include Only'
                        AND EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1
                            FROM `tabSpecial Shift Assignment Employee Table` emps
                            WHERE emps.employee = e.employee
                            AND emps.parent = ssa.name
                        )
                    )
                    OR ssa.include_employees = 'Exclude Only'
                )
            )
        -- تحويل باقي الجداول المرتبطة بالشفت إلى LEFT JOIN
        LEFT JOIN `tabDepartment` dep ON dep.name = e.department
        LEFT JOIN `tabShift Type` st ON st.name = ssa.shift_type
        LEFT JOIN `tabShift Type` st2 ON st2.name = ssa.shift_type_2
        LEFT JOIN `tabDays of Week Table` dow

            AND dow.parentfield = 'days_of_week'
        GROUP BY
            dep.department_name,
            e.designation,
            e.branch,
            e.employee_name,
            e.name,
            ssa.title,
            ssa.include_employees,
            ssa.shift_type,
            ssa.is_default,

    ) AS inner_results
) AS final_filter

    (emp_has_default_flag = 1 AND is_default = 1)

    -- الموظف لديه شفتات ولكن ليس بينها شفت افتراضي (نعرضها كلها)
    (emp_has_default_flag = 0)
    OR
    -- الموظف ليس لديه أي شفت على الإطلاق (الحالة الجديدة)
    (emp_has_default_flag IS NULL);
""", as_dict=True)
